verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy for LangGraph; the only version-related mention is a migration note for langchain-mcp-adapters (langgraph-docs-31), not a formal policy. A community comment even flags that the framework 'often introduces breaking changes' without proper documentation (langgraph-comm-8), reinforcing the absence of a stable versioning/deprecation commitment.
